newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa bond mkt turnover at 300 bln rand in May.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa bond mkt turnover at 300 bln rand in May.

text.p: Total turnover on the South African bond market approached the 300 billion rand mark in May, of which nearly a quarter was accounted for by non-residents, the Bond Exchange said on Wednesday.

The exchange said that turnover in the month rose to 298.46 billion rand from 249.94 billion rand in April. Total foreign purchases and sales amounted to 66.96 billion rand, representing 23 percent of total market turnover.
Offshore trades directly between non-residents rose 16.3 percent to 62.18 billion rand, bringing total offshore trades to 251.93 billion rand in the year to date.
Repurcase transactions accounted for 52 percent of trade -- unchanged from April.
